issue.title: Bug: `test_kdump.py` fails because of recent 7250e kdump change

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

New Nokia kdump changes, changes reboot-cause behaviour on kdump. When sup kdumps, LCs now have reboot-cause `Heartbeat with the Supervisor card lost` instead of `cold`

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `test_kdump.py` and see failures, check logs for reboot-cause

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

For 7250e, test should check for `REBOOT_TYPE_SUPERVISOR_HEARTBEAT_LOSS` instead of `REBOOT_TYPE_COLD`
